notes: Owner build only: the three Sunbringers join Roscaelifer as full characters, remade from scratch with new research (the wiki, the story transcripts and Google AI Mode).

Eldreda, Director of the Administrative Affairs Department, is regal in public and painfully awkward in private. She rehearses her speeches with marked pauses, carries everything alone, and secretly sings and plays guitar.

Lindverne, Director of the Airspace Patrol, is a bubbly prankster who hates being called Lady Lindverne. She loves Starlight Knight, wages war on broccoli, and is frustrated by her older sister's secrets.

Dracaene, Director of the Central Computing Department, is an earnest, absent-minded genius who sees Bangboo as her little siblings. She looks and acts like a child, so she is fully protected: no romance or sexual content.
Each sister has her own schedule, her relationships with each other, Velina and Norma, and their secret (they are Enchainers). They also share a Sunday dinner together.
